name: Porous-vessel evaporative cooling
mechanism: Water evaporating from a wetted porous shell removes sensible heat from the storage chamber.
status: source verified; ORPHEUS design validation pending
evidence_scope: Primary experiments support the mechanism and climate sensitivity; they do not validate the current ORPHEUS geometry or food-safety claims.

sources.title: Design and measured performance of a porous evaporative cooler for preservation of fruits and vegetables
sources.supports: Measured a porous clay food cooler and reported chamber temperature depression varying from approximately 0.1 to 12 degrees Celsius, with performance strongly affected by seasonal weather.

sources.title: Evaporative cooler using a porous material to be used for preservation of food
sources.supports: Tested a wetted charcoal porous cooler and reported a 10 to 13 degrees Celsius reduction from ambient under the tested conditions.

name: Night-sky radiative cooling
mechanism: A sky-facing infrared emitter rejects heat through the atmospheric transparency window to a colder effective sky temperature.
status: source verified; ORPHEUS design validation pending
evidence_scope: Primary experiments support nocturnal cold-storage potential; they do not validate performance in the target climate or the current hybrid design.

sources.title: Performance of a heat pipe assisted night sky radiative cooler
sources.supports: A constructed night-sky refrigerator reached a 12.8 degrees Celsius cold-chamber temperature at 20 degrees Celsius ambient and reported 628 kilojoules per square metre per night under clear skies.

sources.title: Passive directional sub-ambient daytime radiative cooling
sources.supports: Demonstrated sub-ambient radiative cooling using low-cost directional shielding, while identifying solar and parasitic heat-control requirements.

name: Thermal mass buffering
mechanism: A material with substantial heat capacity absorbs transient heat gains and delays or reduces temperature peaks when it can later discharge to a cooler sink.
limitations: requires a regeneration period or cooler sink
status: source verified; ORPHEUS design validation pending
evidence_scope: Experiments support thermal-mass placement and buffering effects; they do not prove that adding mass alone creates refrigeration.

sources.title: Thermal storage mass in radiative cooling systems
sources.supports: Experimentally found thermal-storage mass and its location significant for obtainable cooling power and internal temperatures in a nocturnal-radiation cooling system.

sources.title: Evaluation of the Passive Cooling Potential of Thermal Mass Inherent in Medium to Large Commercial Buildings
sources.supports: Evaluated passive-cooling potential and emphasized exposed surface area and heat-transfer limits rather than assuming unlimited benefit from greater mass depth.

name: Passive phase-change cold storage
mechanism: A charged phase-change material absorbs heat near its melting temperature, buffering a chamber without continuous compressor operation during discharge.
status: source verified; ORPHEUS design validation pending
evidence_scope: Primary experiments support cold buffering after charging; PCM is energy storage, not an independent source of cold.

sources.title: Experimental study on cold storage phase-change materials and quick-freezing plate in household refrigerators
sources.supports: Tested a low-temperature PCM plate for food freezing and measured changes in freezing time and water loss compared with reference methods.

sources.title: Investigation on PCM-Based cold storage performance under variable charging temperatures and layout configurations
sources.supports: Experimentally evaluated a passive portable cold-storage chamber with PCM and quantified storage duration, effectiveness, and layout sensitivity.

name: Buoyancy-driven stack ventilation
mechanism: Density differences caused by temperature gradients drive air through vertically separated openings or a shaft, enabling heat removal when incoming air is cooler.
limitations: cannot cool below inlet-air temperature without another sink
status: source verified; ORPHEUS design validation pending
evidence_scope: Full-scale and component experiments support airflow generation and its sensitivity; they do not prove refrigeration or target-chamber performance by themselves.

sources.title: Experiments in Natural Ventilation for Passive Cooling
sources.supports: Used a naturally ventilated three-level office building to study stack configurations, opening size and position, neutral pressure level, airflow, and night-cooling interaction with building mass.

sources.title: A study on a ventilation stack integrated with a light pipe
sources.supports: Measured a buoyancy- and wind-assisted ventilation stack at nearly ten air changes per hour in the experimental room, while documenting dependence on coupled heat-transfer and wind effects.
